Chapter 7170: Golden World

Chapter 7170: Golden World

Golden was one of the nine major worlds, albeit the smallest one. Nonetheless, it was still far larger than any firmament or minor world.

It enjoyed the most peace. Both mortals and immortals had little bloodlust due to a shared faith - the Golden Law.

They worshipped this phenomenon and once they died, they returned to it. Despite total dominion, it was different than Divine Firmament and the divine beasts.

In the latter, the divine beasts enslaved all beings. Everything in Divine Firmament belonged to them. The lack of conflict allowed this world to prosper but in reality, all were born as slaves.

In Golden, the law balanced everything. Its creator was a celestial immortal whose name was long forgotten. Thus, everyone called them Golden Law or Golden World. Either way, this immortal was this world and vice versa.

At the start, the immortal appeared occasionally while honing their cultivation. These appearances became fewer and fewer. Rumor has it that they had a paramita shell, preparing to create an apex power.

Others said that their lifespan had run out; their sole purpose was to create a barrier to prevent outside immortals from destroying this world.

Li Qiye entered Golden World and came across a woman radiating golden laws. Halos revolved around her; each containing countless worlds. This gave her a lofty and transcendent appearance.

Behind her was the image of a great tree with leaves as large as planets. This tree was also built by the golden laws.

She sat cross-legged and was barefoot. The profundities of her great dao scattered across the world, enlightening all beings. They resonated unknowingly and made the laws stronger, fortifying and tempering their world.

External peace meant internal peace. Thus, they wholeheartedly accepted the golden laws. The laws’ power appeared inexhaustible, the same couldn’t be said about the worldly energies and dao powers in the other eight worlds.

Li Qiye let out a sigh while looking at this scene. After a long while, she opened her eyes and the dao sounds stopped.

More profound truths merged into every corner of the world and all living beings. The natural order began flowing again; all went back to their ordinary lives.
